nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid over-committing to production at the expense of tech or economy. Do not neglect scouting for potential early pressure.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue developing your economy and technology while strengthening your ground army. Maintain defensive structures and keep scouting for early pressure.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you see signs of opponent tech (e.g., Roach Warren, Spire) or if you face early pressure.
nodes.next_state_summary: Continue macro development, possibly adding more production or tech structures as the game progresses.

nodes.strategic_reason: Your heavy tech and economy investment will pay off if you can survive the early game. Maintaining a strong ground army and defense deters early Zergling aggression.

nodes.strategic_reason: Your heavy economy and production will allow you to out-macro the Zerg if you can avoid early damage. Tech investment gives you options for midgame.
nodes.title: Early-Midgame Macro Expansion
